profile.headline: Sports Technology Engineer | Athlete Data, Recruiting & Highlight Platforms | 3 iOS Apps Shipped | 6 Yrs Fintech & Trading Data | APIs & Integrations
profile.summary:
Six years building the infrastructure prop trading firms run on. Now I build technology for athletes.

I've seen the prop firm industry from both ends — a $100M company and one doing under $25k a month — as an employee and as a contractor. Data pipelines, payout systems, internal tools, the databases everything depends on.

Then I started building sports technology, and it stopped feeling like work.

What I've shipped:

→ GIC Verified — athlete verification and recruiting exposure. 1,100+ athletes on the platform.
→ NextPlay Highlights — highlights and media management for athletes, teams, and organizations. 100+ members.
→ FlagPlay — the dedicated database for girls flag football. Verified combine results, film, and performance data.
→ CoachMe — AI sports coach for athlete development.
→ Basketball Ballers — tournaments, athlete registration, and community events.

Three of those are live iOS apps that made it through App Store review. The work runs on integrations with NFL team, NFL FLAG Football, and NFL Combine data.

The thread through all of it is the same: high-accountability systems where the numbers have to be right. Biometric watch lists in Afghanistan. Trader payouts. Verified combine results. Three very different domains, one discipline.

Military and law enforcement background, with an active Secret Security Clearance.

I build my own tooling too — VZT-Flow is open source, signed and notarized by Apple, and runs on macOS and Windows.

What to reach out about:

• Sports tech — athlete data, recruiting platforms, highlights, performance and combine data
• Fintech and prop trading — payouts, reporting, trading infrastructure, dashboards
• API and data integrations between systems that were never designed to talk to each other

No's are free. Conversations are free.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description:
I build, deploy, and run production software for clients in sports and finance: web and mobile apps, data pipelines, and the release tooling around them.

Engineering
• NextPlay (nextplayhighlights.com): sole engineer. Next.js and TypeScript web app plus a React Native app on the App Store and Google Play, on Supabase PostgreSQL through Prisma, with Mux video, Stripe billing, and server-side reel rendering (ffmpeg, Remotion). 22 Vercel cron schedules run the job queue and health checks; 72 schema migrations; about 480 test files; a release script keeps both app stores on the same version. 1,400+ commits since May 2026.
• Football University Team Carolina (fbuteamcarolina.com): replaced the team's Squarespace site with a Next.js app on Supabase. Registration forms feed an admin CRM; cron jobs handle the email queue, Google Sheets sync, and nightly backups. Ran the DNS cutover without disrupting their Google Workspace email.
• Shipped three iOS apps through App Store review.
• Hosting and operations on Vercel and AWS: scheduled jobs, database migrations, webhook and auth checks, CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
• Open source: VZT-Flow (Rust, on-device voice dictation for macOS and Windows, signed and notarized by Apple), Cross-Model-Agents (commit-blocking code review across two model providers), and MCP servers. 15 public repos at github.com/vonzelle-vzt.

Sports technology
• GIC Verified (1,100+ athletes), FlagPlay (combine results and player data for girls flag football), CoachMe, and Basketball Ballers.
• Data integrations for NFL team, NFL FLAG Football, and NFL Combine data.

Fintech and trading
• Internal tools, databases, and dashboards for prop trading firms: payouts, risk, and trading data.
• TradeScript AI: generates working Pine Script and NinjaScript code from a written trading idea.

Stack: Python, SQL, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, React Native, PostgreSQL, Supabase, AWS, Vercel, GitHub Actions.

positions.title: Biometrics Specialist
positions.description:
	Directly responsible for maintenance of over $10,000 worth of Biometric equipment, updated the software on the BATS and HIIDE on a weekly basis ensuring that the theater watch list was up to date. Sought out by other resident units on Forward Operation Base Ghazni due to subject matter expertise regarding the Biometric equipment and software updates.

	Instrumental in the institution and enforcement of FOB Ghazni Facility Access and Enforcement Policy, through this policy, 990 Local National and Third Country Nationals were screened and processed through Biometrics and issued an identification badge access for access to FOB Ghazni. 

	Instrumental in the development of cooperating relationships with the Polish Military police in support of Task Force White Eagle. Worked side by side with polish Military Police to provide security of FOB Ghazni during official visits by Polish Minister of National Defense and numerous General Officers. Was recognized by the Polish Military Police for outstanding dedication to both U.S. and Polish Military Police mission.

	Dedication to the mission and attention to detail which helped identify 10 individuals with access to Fob Ghazni, who were currently Watch List. Utilized tact and professionalism while removing these individuals from FOB Ghazni and ensured their access was no longer permitted. Through these efforts, 55 local national employees were found to be involved in criminal activities against coalition forces and were subsequently placed on the Watch List though Biometrics.

positions.title: Data Engineer / Payouts Operations Manager
positions.description:
Oversee and prepare accurate and timely payout statements for funded traders based on trading performance and profit sharing agreements. Ensure all payouts comply with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

Incorporate robust data engineering practices to maintain and optimize pipelines that ingest, transform, and validate financial data used in payout calculations. Build and manage scalable, high-performance data infrastructure to support reporting, analytics, and compliance requirements.

Collaborate cross-functionally with analytics and engineering teams to design data models that ensure consistency, integrity, and accessibility of financial and operational data. Leverage SQL, Python, and modern data platforms (e.g., dbt, Snowflake, RedShift, Re-Tool, Looker Studio) to enable self-service analytics and automated reporting.

Identify opportunities for process optimization and automation to improve efficiency and accuracy for all financial data. Design and implement ETL workflows and data validation checks to reduce manual processes and minimize risk.

Partner with stakeholders in preparing and delivering reports, suggesting improvements to enhance the overall client experience. Translate business requirements into data solutions that deliver actionable insights and support strategic decision-making.

Identify and implement innovative solutions to automate and optimize processes while ensuring adherence to compliance and operational risk management directives. Drive strategic initiatives centered on leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies to improve scalability, reliability, and business value of data systems.

positions.description:
Easton Consulting Technologies is a global proprietary consulting firm that launches and operates prop firms serving retail traders worldwide.

• Data analysis and operations management across prop firm clients — analyzed trader performance and client financial data to support payout decisions and reporting.
• Managed day-to-day client financial operations, making sure payouts lined up with profit-sharing agreements and company policy.
• Built and maintained recurring reporting for leadership and stakeholders using SQL and BI tooling.
• Identified process gaps and automation opportunities that cut manual work and improved operational data accuracy.

positions.description:

• Owned payout operations end to end: reviewed trading performance, calculated profit-sharing, and issued accurate, timely payout statements.
• Ran reconciliation and validation against trader financial data before payouts were released.
• Partnered with support and compliance to resolve payout disputes and edge cases.

projects.title: VZT-Flow — Open-Source On-Device Voice Dictation
projects.description:
Open-source local voice dictation for macOS and Windows. Hold a key, talk, and the transcript lands at your cursor. Fully on-device and private, signed and notarized by Apple so it just opens, and verified on real hardware on both platforms. Parakeet TDT ASR with optional Qwen3 cleanup. Ships a CLI and an MCP voice-input tool for Claude Code.

github.com/vonzelle-vzt/vzt-flow
